title: event-settings-1.html
content: Important Change to Event Settings and Event Groups {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} applied at the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} level will override all {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} applied at the individual {{variable.Object_Event}} level. Previously, {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} applied at the {{variable.Object_Event}} level overrode {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} applied to an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . About Event Settings The {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} object stores all of the information about how your {{variable.Object_Event}} will look on the front end and how everything will be processed on the back end. An {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record determines the look and feel for all related {{variable.Object_Event}} s, removing the need to define the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} 's fields for each {{variable.Object_Event}} that you create. When you install the {{variable.Product_Events}} app, we deploy a default {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. We recommend starting with the default record. After you create your first {{variable.Object_Event}} , customize the default {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record to update the look and feel and determine which information you want to share. Benefits Create different {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} based on your {{variable.Object_Event}} types. Define these settings once, and each related {{variable.Object_Event}} inherits the settings. Important Features There are three important features tied to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} object: {{variable.Object_RelationshipSettings}} , {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} , and Event to Campaign Sync. Group your {{variable.Object_Event}} s by their look and feel and how they need to interact with each of the following features. Relationship Settings If you have two {{variable.Object_Event}} s each with its own {{variable.Object_RelationshipSettings}} record, then you will need two different {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} records. {{variable.Object_Event}} 1 {{variable.Object_RelationshipSettings}} record 1: Generate new {{variable.Object_Lead}} s/ {{variable.Object_Contact}} s from {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s that aren’t already in your system. {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record 1 {{variable.Object_Event}} 2 {{variable.Object_RelationshipSettings}} record 2: Do not generate new {{variable.Object_Lead}} s/ {{variable.Object_Contact}} s from {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s that aren’t already in your system. {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record 2 Event to Campaign Sync If you have two {{variable.Object_Event}} s that support members, each with its own {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} selection, then you will need two different {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} records. {{variable.Object_Event}} 1 Membership page registrants {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = “New Member” {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record 1 {{variable.Object_Event}} 2 Weekly meeting participants {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = "Responded" {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record 2 Find the Event Settings Tab Click the App Launcher icon. Type "Events (Admin)" and select the Events (Admin) app. Click the Event Settings tab. For the Event Settings List View, we suggest changing the view from “Recently Viewed" to "View All" and then pinning "View All." Enable Payment Methods If the {{variable.Object_Event}} is paid, select how {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can pay during Checkout. {{variable.Picklist_ETSettings_EnPM_PayLa}} will create an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} that you can send to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} later. ACH Payment Methods The {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is the only gateway that accepts (electronic fund transfer) ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} s during the {{variable.Product_Events}} checkout process.  For all other gateways, we recommend using the Pay Later option . To activate an {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} , go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , and add “ACH” to {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_EnabledPM}} . For some organizations, the “ACH” picklist value will need to be activated via Setup.  General Information The General section and accompanying fields are located above the Branding & Language section on the out-of-the-box {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} object page layout for new installs. {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HideQRfromA}} {{variable.Field_ETSettings_WaitlistMsg}} {{variable.Field_ETSetting_AllowEditAtten}}   If enabled (checked), an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can update their AttendeeLink fields regardless of the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} value. IMPORTANT: For an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to make changes, their {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} must be set to "Invited". If disabled, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can NOT change their information. Ticket Information Hide Price Range When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HidePriceRa}} = “Yes,” the price range text will be hidden from the {{variable.Object_Event}} overview page, right above the register button. Overview Pricing When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_OvervwPrici}} = “No,” the price range component will be hidden from the {{variable.Object_Event}} overview page. Donations The picklist field {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrDon}} (create_opportunities_for_donations_c) was added to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . The default setting is “No.” If {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrDon}} = “Yes” in the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} , an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} record will be created for each {{variable.Object_EventItem}} where {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = {{variable.Picklist_EventItem_Donation}} . Each new {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} will include the following information: {{variable.Field_Opportunity_AccountName}} = {{variable.Object_Attendee}} or Donor's full name {{variable.Field_Opportunity_CloseDate}} = date the Donation was made {{variable.Field_Opportunity_Amount}} = amount of the Donation {{variable.Field_Opportunity_OpportuOwner}} Main Contact (Primary Registrant) Form Hide the Main Contact Address during Checkout When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HidMainAddr}} = “Yes,” the related address fields will be hidden from the UI during checkout. Exception - Please Read The {{variable.Field_Contact_Phone}} field will be visible on the Contact Information form even if the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HidMainAddr}} field is set to “Yes” on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . The {{variable.Object_Contact}} s {{variable.Field_Contact_Phone}} is a required field for the BT Events Attendee Matching Rule. Set to Yes Set to No Hide Main Contact Company Name in Checkout When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HidMnCompNa}} is set to “Yes,” the company field will be hidden from the UI. Design/UI Background Color Enter the hex number in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_BkgrndColor}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}} 's background color. Primary Color Enter the hex number in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_PrimaryColo}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}} 's primary color. Card Color Theme Select {{variable.Picklist_ETSettings_Card_Dark}} or {{variable.Picklist_ETSettings_Card_Light}} for the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CardClrThem}} . The default is {{variable.Picklist_ETSettings_Card_Light}} . Font Change the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Font}} of your {{variable.Object_Event}} listing. All Google Fonts that are listed as picklist values on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Font}} field are currently supported. To add your own custom font, use the following example: Custom CSS Injection - Example 3 . Injecting Custom CSS Injecting custom CSS into an {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} will apply the CSS to all {{variable.Object_Event}} s related to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . This can be done by adding the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustmCSSUrl}} field to your {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout. This example will change the title to red, and the background of the title to green. .page-event-details h1.title { background-color: red; } .page-event-a1q0I00000A58pwQAB h1.title { background-color: green; } This example will hide the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartTime}} for your {{variable.Object_Event}} . .welcome.ng-star-inserted { display: hidden; } .start-dates { display:none !important; } #date-and-time { display:none !important; } Note: Custom CSS must be correctly served as a file with a MIME type of 'text/CSS' in order for it to load correctly. Favicon URL Add a URL to the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field on the related {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record to link a branded Favicon. All {{variable.Object_Event}} s linked to an {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} with this field populated will display the custom Favicon instead of the default Blackthorn Favicon. Use one of the following ways to set a Favicon URL. Set on a Single Event Set the Favicon on an {{variable.Object_Event}} -by- {{variable.Object_Event}} basis by using the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record that is related to an {{variable.Object_Event}} or series of {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Upload the image to your Salesforce Files. Open the file. Click Public Link . Set the {{variable.SF_File_ExpirationDate}} = “Off” Set the {{variable.SF_File_Password}} = “Off” Click Copy Link . Open the URL in a new browser and click Download . Navigate to all downloads and find the image file. Copy the URL (downloaded file). You may need to right-click the file and click Copy Link Address . Open the Event Settings record related to the Event. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Enter the URL in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field.  Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Set on All Events Set the Favicon URL globally, which will apply the Favicon to all {{variable.Object_Event}} s and {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s in the org. Upload the image to your Salesforce Files. Open the file. Click Public Link . Set the {{variable.SF_File_ExpirationDate}} = “Off” Set the {{variable.SF_File_Password}} = “Off” Click Copy Link . Open the URL in a new browser and click Download . Navigate to all downloads and find the image file. Copy the URL (downloaded file). You may need to right-click the file and click Copy Link Address . Go to the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. Click the Settings tab. Enter the URL in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field.   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Example The Blackthorn B is the default Favicon and in this {{variable.Object_Event}} example, it was replaced by populating the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field Note: The default sizing for a Favicon is 16x16 pixels. Non-Salesforce File Storage If you are using public Salesforce files or Google Drive links in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field, follow the instructions below. Create the URL using this format: https://drive.google.com/u/1/uc?id=$FILE_ID&export=download Change “$FILE_ID” to the desired FILE_ID. Other Settings 24-hour Format If you would like to change the date format on your {{variable.Object_Event}} overview page from am/pm to 24-hour, update the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Show24hrfor}} to {{variable.Picklist_Yes}} . Block Duplicate Registrations The {{variable.Field_EVSetting_BlockDupRegist}} field (conference360__Block_Duplicate_Registrations__c) allows users to block duplicate registrations. When {{variable.Field_EVSetting_BlockDupRegist}} is checked, duplicate {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s will NOT be created when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers twice in a row while the first registration is still being processed. Note: Current users need to manually add the {{variable.Field_EVSetting_BlockDupRegist}} field to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout. Duplicate Rules and ERS Records Duplicate rules ensure completed and processed registrations are handled by duplication logic when configured to block duplicates on creation, including {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} records with {{variable.Field_ERS_Status}} set to “To Process” and a value in the new {{variable.Field_ERS_PrimaryEmail}} (conference360__Primary_Email__c) field. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSetting_BlockDupRegist}} = “True” and an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} submits a registration that has an {{variable.Object_ERS}} record with {{variable.Field_ERS_Status}} set to “To Process” or “Completed” and the {{variable.Field_ERS_PrimaryEmail}} field is populated, then the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will get an error when they try to submit a duplicate registration. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSetting_BlockDupRegist}} = “False” and an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} submits a registration that has an {{variable.Object_ERS}} record with {{variable.Field_ERS_Status}} set to “To Process” or “Completed” and the {{variable.Field_ERS_PrimaryEmail}} field is populated, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to submit a duplicate registration successfully. Contact and Payment Details for Free Events The {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ' {{variable.Field_EVSetting_RemoInfoFreeEV}} (conference360__Remove_Info_Page_for_Free_Events__c ) field allows users to add or remove the contact information/payment details page for free {{variable.Object_Event}} s. The picklist values are “Yes” or “No,” and the default value is no. When {{variable.Field_EVSetting_RemoInfoFreeEV}} = “Yes” (enabled), the last page during checkout is hidden. This page usually asks for additional contact/payment information. This feature can only be enabled for free {{variable.Object_Event}} s. If a free {{variable.Object_Event}} has the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSetting_RemoInfoFreeEV}} and {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_EnableCaptc}} fields enabled, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see the reCAPTCHA on the last page of the registration process. Note: Current users may need to manually add the {{variable.Field_EVSetting_RemoInfoFreeEV}} field to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout. Copy Related Info to All Responses When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers a group, they can now click the Copy related info to all the responses button to copy their {{variable.Object_Form}} responses to all {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s in the group if the new {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_EVSetting_FormRespAttGrp}} field is set to "Yes." The new field removes the repeated copy-paste step and decreases the time it takes to register everyone. Important Notes The {{variable.Object_Form}} s must be identical and have the same {{variable.Object_Form}} record ID. The Copy related info to all the responses button will only be displayed if the first {{variable.Object_EventItem}} shown has custom questions. Countries to Exclude or Include The {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CountryExcl}} field defines which countries should be removed as available options for {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s during checkout. If a country is excluded, payment cards from that country cannot be used for checkout. Since the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CountryExcl}} picklist allows up to 100 options, which may be overwhelming for Attendees, you can instead use the {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field. The {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field gives you the option to overwrite the values in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CountryExcl}} field. To use the {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field, choose values from the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CountryExcl}} picklist and place them in the {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field, separated by commas. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will now see only the countries in the {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field as available options in the Attendee Info Form’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Country}} picklist. NOTE: If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CountryExcl}} and {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} fields both contain values, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will only see the values in the {{variable.Field_EVSettings_CountryInclud}} field in the Attendee Info Form’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Country}} picklist. Custom Cancelation Message If your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} cancels their registration via their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} , you can replace the default cancelation message with one of your own. Add the message to the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_TickCancMsg}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Date Format Use the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DateFormat}} field to change the date format on the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage. The included picklist values are as follows. MM/DD/YY MM/DD/YYYY DD/MM/YY DD/MM/YYYY YY/MM/DD YYYY/MM/DD Disable Auto-Add to Default Event Group The {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSet_DisAutoAddDefEVGrp}} (conference360__Disable_Auto_Add_to_Default_Event_Group__c ) field allows Event Organizers to determine whether an {{variable.Object_Event}} should automatically be added to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} that is marked as the default {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . If {{variable.Field_EVSet_DisAutoAddDefEVGrp}} is unchecked (default setting), the new {{variable.Object_Event}} will be added automatically to the default {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . If {{variable.Field_EVSet_DisAutoAddDefEVGrp}} is checked (enabled), the new {{variable.Object_Event}} will not automatically be added to the default {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Disable Checkout as Someone Else When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisCheSElse}} is checked, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not see the "Someone Else" option on checkout. This field will need to be added to your {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout. Once the box is checked, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will no longer see the "Someone Else" option. Disable Not You When {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisableNotY}} is checked and an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} receives an invite from an {{variable.AttendeeLink}} , they will not see the Not You button. A common use case for this is with invite-only {{variable.Object_Event}} s and with {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s forwarding invite emails to block other people from registering. Enable Event Search Options If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSettings_SearchBar}} field is set to “On,” {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can search the {{variable.Object_Event}} for related information using the following search criteria. {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s: {{variable.Field_Sponsor_SponsorName}} {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s: {{variable.Field_Speaker_FirstName}} and {{variable.Field_Speaker_LastName}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s: {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_FirstName}} , {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_LastName}} , and {{variable.Field_Attendee_Title}} {{variable.Object_Session}} s: {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}} {{variable.Object_EventFAQ}} : existing questions: A {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Question}} in simple or richTextQuestion form and an {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Answer}} in simple or richTextAnswer form new questions: A {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Question}} in simpleTextQuestion form and an {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Answer}} in simpleTextAnswer form Enable Social Sharing {{snippet.En_Dis_able_ShareSocialMedia}} Separate Donations and Products from Tickets Create a customized checkout experience by separating the Donations and Products sections from the Tickets and placing them on their own pages. Separating everything helps {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s find what they need. The Donations page offers an intuitive and focused interface, while the Products page highlights products to ensure they are visible to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. To place the Donations and Products sections on their own pages during checkout, set the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} field {{variable.Field_EVSetting_DisplayDPsepar}} to “Yes” (checked).  To continue using the current functionality, leave {{variable.Field_EVSetting_DisplayDPsepar}} set to “No” (unchecked). Note: If a {{variable.Object_Form}} is related to a Donation or Product record, the {{variable.Object_Form}} will be displayed on the page with the Donation or Product. Show/Hide the Join Video Stream Button The {{variable.Field_EVSettings_RemURLAttLink}} field allows users to hide the Join Video Stream button to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s on the AttendeeLink page when the value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} or {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} field is removed.  If the value is set to "No" or left blank, the existing behavior will continue. If the value is set to "Yes" and the value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} or {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} field is deleted, the information in the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field ( Join Video Stream button) will be removed. Create Opportunity From Checkout Check {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrChe}} if you want an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} automatically created from an {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout. Opportunity Open Stage Name Defines the stage for an open opportunity created from the {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout and used with "Pay Later" {{variable.Object_Event}} checkouts. For example, if {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrChe}} is enabled and “Pay Later” was selected during checkout, the opportunity will be created with the name in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_OppOpenStag}} field. Opportunity Successful Stage Name Defines the stage for a successful opportunity created from the {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout and used with completed {{variable.Object_Event}} checkouts. For example, if {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrChe}} is enabled and the checkout was paid successfully, the opportunity will be created with the name in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_OppSuccStaN}} field. Create Zero Dollar Opportunities If the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Crt0DollOpp}} field is set to “None” or “Yes” and {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrChe}} is checked, {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} records will be created for free and $0.00 {{variable.Object_Event}} orders. If the value is “No” and {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CrtOppfrChe}} is checked, {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} records will NOT be created for free and $0.00 {{variable.Object_Event}} orders. Opportunity Record Type The {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_OppRecType}} field defines the Label of the record type you want when an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} is created.
